subject: math
question: 计算积分 $I = \int \ln \left(\sqrt{1 + x} +\sqrt{1 - x}\right)\mathrm{d}x$
answer: I = x \ln (\sqrt {1 + x} + \sqrt {1 - x}) - \frac {x}{2} + \frac {1}{2} \arcsin x + C.

steps.text: 分析 适宜直接做分部积分.

方法1

$$
\begin{array}{l} I = x \ln (\sqrt {1 + x} + \sqrt {1 - x}) - \int \frac {x \left(\frac {1}{2 \sqrt {1 + x}} - \frac {1}{2 \sqrt {1 - x}}\right)}{\sqrt {1 + x} + \sqrt {1 - x}} d x \\ = x \ln (\sqrt {1 + x} + \sqrt {1 - x}) - \frac {1}{2} \int \frac {x (\sqrt {1 - x} - \sqrt {1 + x})}{(\sqrt {1 + x} + \sqrt {1 - x}) \sqrt {1 - x ^ {2}}} d x \\ = x \ln (\sqrt {1 + x} + \sqrt {1 - x}) + \frac {1}{4} \int \frac {(\sqrt {1 - x} - \sqrt {1 + x}) ^ {2}}{\sqrt {1 - x ^ {2}}} d x \\ = x \ln (\sqrt {1 + x} + \sqrt {1 - x}) + \frac {1}{2} \int \frac {1 - \sqrt {1 - x ^ {2}}}{\sqrt {1 - x ^ {2}}} d x \\ = x \ln (\sqrt {1 + x} + \sqrt {1 - x}) + \frac {1}{4} [ \arcsin x - x ] + C. \end{array}
$$

方法2 用组合积分法. 记 $J = \int \ln \left(\sqrt{1 + x} - \sqrt{1 - x}\right) \mathrm{d}x$ ，则

①

$$
\begin{array}{l} I + J = \int \left(\ln \left(\sqrt {1 + x} + \sqrt {1 - x}\right) + \ln \left(\sqrt {1 + x} - \sqrt {1 - x}\right)\right) d x = \int \ln 2 x d x = x \ln 2 x - x + C _ {1}. \\ I - J = \int \left(\ln \left(\sqrt {1 + x} + \sqrt {1 - x}\right) - \ln \left(\sqrt {1 + x} - \sqrt {1 - x}\right)\right) d x = \int \ln \frac {1 + \sqrt {1 - x ^ {2}}}{x} d x \\ \stackrel {{x = \sin t}} {{=}} \int \ln \cot \frac {t}{2} d \sin t = \sin t \cdot \ln \cot \frac {t}{2} + \int d t = \sin t \cdot \ln \cot \frac {t}{2} + t + C _ {2} \\ = x \ln \frac {\left(\sqrt {1 + x} + \sqrt {1 - x}\right) ^ {2}}{2 x} + \arcsin x + C _ {2}. \end{array}\tag{②}
$$

联立①，②式，解得

$$
I = x \ln (\sqrt {1 + x} + \sqrt {1 - x}) - \frac {x}{2} + \frac {1}{2} \arcsin x + C.
$$

solution.final_answer: I = x \ln (\sqrt {1 + x} + \sqrt {1 - x}) - \frac {x}{2} + \frac {1}{2} \arcsin x + C.

cdps.expected: 通常对数/反三角/幂作 u，指数/三角作 dv；同类项移到左边解出。

meta.commentary: 评注 “组合积分法”的关键是引入适当的积分式 $J$ ，使得 $k_{1}I + k_{2}J$ 与 $k_{3}I + k_{4}J$ 易于计算（常数 $k_{1}k_{4} - k_{2}k_{3} \neq 0$ ），再求解关于 $I, J$ 的线性方程组得到所求积分（常取 $k_{1} = k_{2} = k_{3} = 1, k_{4} = -1$ ）。
